description: SubModel's deploy-free, OpenAI-compatible hosted inference service for open-weight language models.
prompt_training_notes: InstaGen states that prompts, outputs, and conversation history are not retained, but does not publish a separate model-training policy.
regional_pricing_notes: InstaGen publishes one USD-denominated token price list and does not advertise regional price variants.

sources.notes: Official current InstaGen inventory, exact Hugging Face model identifiers, categories, and USD token prices.
Official OpenAI-compatible base URL, bearer authentication, model discovery, chat-completions, text-completions, and concurrency limit.
Official InstaGen privacy policy documents no prompt, output, conversation, or file retention and multi-jurisdiction processing.
Official product page identifies InstaGen as SubModel's hosted model API and publishes context limits for its displayed catalogue.

verification.notes: Official documentation reconciles ten current InstaGen model routes, exact identifiers, prices, API surface, rate limits, and privacy constraints; routing remains disabled because Phaseo has no SubModel executor integration.
